# Favze

> Favze Digital Marketing is an affordable full-service agency with custom packages tailored to your needs. Northern Indiana & Michiana's affordable full-service local digital marketing agency focused on helping businesses become their customer’s favorite local business.

Favze Digital Marketing (Favze, LLC) is based in Middlebury, Indiana, and serves businesses across Northern Indiana and Southwest Michigan (Michiana). Founder and CEO: Riley Catalano (https://rileycatalano.com, https://www.linkedin.com/in/rileycatalano/). Phone and text: 574-747-5012. Email: riley@favze.com.

- [Local SEO Services in Northern Indiana & Michiana](https://favze.com/services/local-seo): Rank in the Google Map Pack, Apple Maps, and AI answers. Favze builds your Google Business Profile, reviews, and citations so nearby customers call you.

- [Favze Insights - Local SEO, AI Search & Marketing Articles](https://favze.com/resources/articles): Practical guides on local SEO, AI search, Google Business Profile, content, and social media for small business owners. Written by Riley Catalano of Favze.
- [How to Make Your Business the Local Favorite](https://favze.com/resources/articles/brand-positioning/how-to-make-business-local-favorite): The reputation, community, and visibility habits that make customers choose you first. A practical guide for Northern Indiana and Michiana business owners.
- [Brand Positioning for Local Businesses](https://favze.com/resources/articles/brand-positioning): Guides to becoming the business your community recommends first. Positioning, reputation, and community authority strategies for local owners.
- [Pillar Pages, Topic Clusters & Internal Linking](https://favze.com/resources/articles/content-marketing/blog-and-article-hierarchy-pillars-clusters-internal-linking): How to organize a blog into pillar pages and topic clusters, and link them so Google and AI search understand your expertise. A practical blueprint.
- [Content Repurposing for the AI Era](https://favze.com/resources/articles/content-marketing/content-repurposing-mastery-ai-era): Turn one piece of content into posts, emails, videos, and AI-ready answers. A repurposing system that saves time and grows reach across every channel.
- [How to Create Evergreen Content That Ranks for Years](https://favze.com/resources/articles/content-marketing/how-to-create-evergreen-content): Build content that keeps bringing customers long after you publish. Topics, structure, and update habits that keep local business pages ranking.
- [Content Marketing for Local Businesses](https://favze.com/resources/articles/content-marketing): Guides to evergreen content, blog structure, internal linking, and repurposing that help local businesses rank on Google and get cited by AI search.
- [The Complete Google Business Profile Checklist](https://favze.com/resources/articles/search-visibility/google-business-profile-checklist): Every Google Business Profile setting, photo, review, and post that helps you rank in the Map Pack. A step-by-step checklist for local business owners.
- [Search Visibility & Local SEO Guides](https://favze.com/resources/articles/search-visibility): Guides to ranking on Google, Google Maps, and AI search. Learn what earns trust, visibility, and customers for local businesses, step by step.
- [Google Local Services Ads: Get to the Top of Google](https://favze.com/resources/articles/search-visibility/local-service-ads-fast-track-top-google): How Local Services Ads work, what the 2026 move into Google Ads means, and how the Google Verified badge gets service businesses more calls and leads.
- [SEO vs. AEO vs. GEO: The New Rules of Online Visibility](https://favze.com/resources/articles/search-visibility/new-rules-online-visibility-seo-aeo-geo): How SEO, Answer Engine Optimization, and Generative Engine Optimization work together, and how to get found on Google, voice search, and AI assistants.
- [What Makes Google Trust a Website (E-E-A-T)](https://favze.com/resources/articles/search-visibility/what-makes-google-trust-a-website): The trust signals Google checks before it ranks a site: E-E-A-T, reviews, technical health, and consistent business info. A clear guide for local businesses.
- [How to Create Engaging Social Media Posts](https://favze.com/resources/articles/social-media-strategy/how-to-create-highly-engaging-social-media-posts): Hooks, formats, and posting habits that earn likes, comments, and shares. A practical guide to social media posts that turn local followers into customers.
- [Social Media Strategy for Local Businesses](https://favze.com/resources/articles/social-media-strategy): Guides to searchable captions, engaging posts, and social strategy that turns local followers into customers. Practical steps for small business owners.
- [Social Media SEO: Write Captions People Can Search](https://favze.com/resources/articles/social-media-strategy/your-cute-captions-arent-searchable): Social platforms work like search engines now. Learn how to write keyword-rich captions that get your business found on Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook.
